candidates.name: locally advanced breast cancer
support_spans: a 4.5 × 5.5 cm irregular, poorly defined, hard mass
overlying ulceration and slight serosanguinous discharge
candidates.why: large tumor size and skin involvement are indicative of locally advanced disease

candidates.name: triple-negative breast cancer
support_spans: serum breast tumor markers were within normal limits
candidates.why: normal tumor markers may suggest a triple-negative subtype

candidates.name: ductal carcinoma
support_spans: a 4.5 × 5.5 cm irregular, poorly defined, hard mass
candidates.why: ductal carcinoma is a common type of breast cancer that can present as a hard mass

candidates.name: invasive ductal carcinoma
support_spans: Breast ultrasound and MRI both classified the lesion as BI-RADS category V
candidates.why: BI-RADS category V lesions are highly suggestive of malignancy, such as invasive ductal carcinoma

candidates.name: metaplastic breast cancer
support_spans: Chest CT demonstrated a right breast mass suggestive of malignancy
candidates.why: CT findings of a malignant-appearing mass may be consistent with metaplastic breast cancer
